description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Repatriation of Export Proceeds into Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made under the Monetary Law Act regarding the repatriation and conversion of export proceeds, which constitutes regulatory matters and legal instruments issued by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. It involves amendments to existing regulations and establishes compliance requirements for exporters, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) that cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
